decisions.reason: The trommel screen has an established customer base from the successful BASIC 518 and remains a core screening product, so withdrawal within a year is highly unlikely.
The mobile high-speed grinder line still needs time to build market traction but aligns with the firm's processing and recycling focus, so we keep it.
The green waste grinder addresses a growing biomass and composting segment, so retaining it supports the firm's resource-saving recycling strategy.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line is a logical fit for recycling and waste-processing customers and has its own product page, so we keep it.
